author: DevCircle IT Consulting GmbH
name: DevC.KPI reporting plugin
description: A starter DevC.KPI reporting plugin repo: one static hello-world widget, a unit-test project, a commented cube/datasource reference, and a deploy bundle script.

pluginName.//: Project/namespace name derived from -n. Any character invalid in a C# identifier (e.g. the
pluginName.//2: hyphen in `ScoutManager-KPI`) becomes `_`, and that ONE safe form is used for folder names,
pluginName.//3: file names, .slnx/csproj paths AND namespaces/classes — so a hyphenated -n still scaffolds a
pluginName.//4: consistent, buildable project. (We drive the rename here instead of `sourceName` because
pluginName.//5: sourceName renames files verbatim but sanitises content, which desyncs paths from folders.)

tenant.description: The engine tenant name this plugin targets: the config/<tenant>/ folder and PluginScope.ForTenants(...). It must EQUAL the tenant name provisioned in the engine (there is no mapping table). If omitted, the lowercased project name is used.
